patches.reason: Delo's agent standard: the root guide adds Delo's rules, fork boundary and repository layout to upstream's commands and conventions, so one guide governs both trees. It replaces upstream's file at the base tag and keeps the CLAUDE.md symlinks.

Delo's agent standard: the documentation standard adds Delo's tiers, writing and trust-wording rules, website section and word-budget targets, so Delo's pages follow the same standard as upstream's. Upstream's rules that Delo does not touch stand unchanged.

Delo's agent standard: the ceilings for AGENTS.md and docs/AGENTS.md rise to fit the text Delo added to them. Delo's architecture page, delo/docs/architecture/README.md, is budgeted at the 2,400-word target that docs/AGENTS.md names.

Delo's agent standard: a section states that Delo's decisions are Agent Notes in this tree beside upstream's, and how Delo notes supersede or cross-link upstream notes. The layout, classes and format rules are unchanged.
Delo's agent standard: the Chinese counterpart of the Delo notes section added to README.md, translated for that section only.
Delo's agent standard: the consistency record re-recorded after the Delo notes section was added to README.md and its Chinese counterpart.
Delo's documentation under delo/docs/ is held to upstream's pairing rules: every page has a Chinese pair and a consistency record.
Delo's documentation under delo/docs/ is held to upstream's pairing rules: the scope cases cover the delo/docs/ inclusion and an out-of-scope Delo path.
Delo's product terms with their Chinese renderings.
States the translation-pairing scope with Delo's delo/docs/ tree included, matching scripts/translation-pairing.ts.

Delo's contribution guide: contributions are welcome under MIT with DCO sign-off, the root AGENTS.md is the one guide, and upstream edits need ledger entries.
The Chinese pair of Delo's contribution guide.
The consistency record of Delo's contribution guide pair.
Delo's code of conduct, Contributor Covenant 2.1, with Delo's enforcement contact.
Delo's security policy: private reporting, supported releases, dependency advisories and dependency-only patch releases.
How Delo is maintained and how decisions are recorded.
Names Delo's maintainer for every path and explicitly for the security-sensitive ones.
Adds Delo's DCO, ledger and changelog checklist to upstream's pull request template.

Adds Delo's workspace globs, the `!delo/apps/docs` exclusion, the `@simplewebauthn/server>@peculiar/asn1-schema` override that passkey signature checks need, and `allowBuilds: false` entries for Delo's packages. Upstream's lines are unchanged. Lead verdict: kept; the allowBuilds additions are all false, so build scripts run no more than stock.
Lockfile importers for Delo's workspace packages; regenerate with pnpm install on an upstream merge, never hand-merge.
Adds an optional scope to the export-JSDoc collector, so Delo's workspaces are checked by the same gate with their own source patterns.
Leaves out the workspace members that pnpm excludes with `!`, so the notices read the members pnpm installs.
Covers the `!`-member exclusion that the notices generator reads.

Leaves link-local IPv4 out of the non-loopback candidates, because a WSL host's link-local address accepts a listen but stalls Web requests, and adds an unzoned IPv6 loopback probe that tests can use to skip the IPv6 case.
Covers the link-local exclusion and the IPv6 loopback probe.
Skips the IPv6 loopback root test when the host cannot listen on ::1, using the probe that scripts/test-non-loopback-address.ts exports.
Declares `*.woff2` font modules for Delo's studio theme fonts.
Exempts the pinned upstream commit field of the divergence ledger and generated pnpm lockfiles from the commit-reference scan, since both record commit identifiers or content hashes by design.
Covers the pinned-commit field exemption and the pnpm lockfile exclusion.
Adds the root pointer to Delo's roadmap in the Delo versus stock guide; upstream has no ROADMAP.md.
Scans Delo's documentation under delo/docs/ with upstream's relative-link rules, so a broken link in a Delo page fails the documentation checks.
Covers the delo/docs/ scope of the relative-link check: a broken link in a Delo page is reported and a Delo file outside delo/docs/ is not scanned.
Scans Delo's documentation under delo/docs/ with upstream's one-line-per-paragraph rule.
Compiles the TypeScript fences in Delo's documentation under delo/docs/ with upstream's documentation typecheck.
Runs Delo's commit standard, delo/apps/tools/src/check-commits.ts, as the commit-msg hook.
Delo's gate workflow: runs each Delo check gate on pull requests and on pushes to v5 and main.
